description: Save a named email segment so the owner can reuse it from Send to. match is any (people with at least one of tags) or all (people with every tag); exclude leaves out anyone with those tags. Use tag key values from list_contact_tag_options. lastVisit narrows to people whose last completed appointment was within the last `days` (when within) or who haven't been back for `days` and have nothing booked (when over). services narrows to people who had one of these service ids (from list_business_services) at a completed appointment. Give at least one tag, lastVisit or service. Changing a segment replaces all of its conditions. Leave out id to create a segment; pass an id from list_email_segments to change one. Names are unique, and a business can save up to 50.
name: save_email_segment
